scope.scope: All five ZIP archives present in docs/incoming, incoming README, and the retired DiophantineConsistency proof-simplification packet explicitly linked by that README. Historical K215 and unrelated archive-placement entries are not re-audited as DiophantineConsistency proposal reports.
scope.method: Read report bodies and targeted detailed notes; inspect nonbaseline artifact inventory; search proposed Lean and notes for current candidate overlap. Original source copies are evidence of baseline, not proposals. No supplied scripts or Lean files were executed. ZIP contents were extracted for text inspection.
scope.limitations: Semantic novelty is assessed against the audited packets, not claimed for all literature or all prior conversations. The ledger groups variants; one item may have multiple reports, and evidence lists representative exact locations rather than every repeated mention.
